    print(f\"--- {name} ---\")

    gy,gx = 18, 32
    for j in range(gy):
        row=''
        for i in range(gx):
            block = mask[j*H//gy:(j+1)*H//gy, i*W//gx:(i+1)*W//gx]
            row += '#' if block.mean()>0.25 else ('.' if block.mean()>0.05 else ' ')
